Pumpkin Pie Apple Crisps
By: Tracy Koslicki
Published: Tuesday, November 4, 2014 - 6:40pm

Ingredients




4 Honey Crisp Apples
Juice from 1/2 lemon
1 tablespoon Pumpkin Pie Spice

Preparation

1 Slice apples with a mandolin 1/6 inch thick into a large bowl.  Squeeze lemon juice over apple slices and mix well.  Sprinkle pumpkin pie spice over apples and mix well. 2 In a dehydrator set at 135 degrees, arrange apple slices on trays and dry for 8-10 hours.

About

Dehydrated apple slices seasoned with Pumpkin Pie Spice = the perfect Fall snack!
